name: Análisis de Patrón Binario Local
description: Computes LBP descriptors to capture micro-texture characteristics. generado por IA images produce estadísticoly distinct LBP distribucións.
mechanism: Compara each pixel with 8 neighbors in circular patrón. Binary codes form histogramas capturing micro-texture. AI images show higher uniform ratios.
parameters: Radius: 1, Neighbors: 8, Pattern type: uniform, Bins: 256
useCase: Detecting synthetic micro-patrones de textura in AI images

references.title: Ojala, T. et al. (2002). Multi-resolution Gray-scale and Rotation Invariant Texture Classification. IEEE TPAMI.
Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
Ahonen, T. et al. (2006). Face Description with Local Binary Patterns. IEEE TPAMI.

strengths:
• Computacionalmente eficiente texture descriptor
• Rotation-invariant with uniform patrones
• Captures micro-texture structures effectively
• Well-studied with extensive literature since 2002
• Robust to monotonic iluminación changes
limitations:
• Sensitive to image noise at pixel level
• Fixed radius limits multi-scale análisis
• Large neighborhoods increase computational cost
• compresión JPEG affects local patrones
• Modern AI can generate realistic micro-textures
